title: The Monk Who Waited for 2027
content:
He watched the banks announce a chain the way some men announce a diet.

Thirty-nine associations. Industry-owned. Permissioned. Targeting 2027. Tokenized deposits, bank stablecoins, an elder-fraud speed bump. They had finished phase one of an RFP. They had not hired anyone to build it. Swift was already there. Customers were not asking. They don't know what to ask for, one CEO said.

Last month the same groups fought the yield. This month they wanted the coin.

He poured the tea. A chain, he thought, is easy to announce when no one has to use it.
